_comment: AUTHORITATIVE expansion allocation manifest (F0:0000-FF:FFFF). Single source of truth. The builder rejects overlaps between regions that are active in the same target, any write outside a declared region/claim, and any placement collision inside a region.

regions.name: BUILD_METADATA
regions.purpose: Build identification block (signature, framework version, target id). Consumer: tools/verify.py only; no game code reads it.

regions.name: RESERVED_F0_LOW
regions.purpose: Reserved. Kept empty so the TECH v0.1 legacy layout (F0:0000-F0:011F) never aliases production code/data.

regions.name: ENGINE_CODE
regions.purpose: New 65816 routines / hook bodies (JML targets from vanilla banks).

regions.name: ENGINE_TABLES
regions.purpose: Engine lookup tables (future: relocated map/monster pointer tables).

regions.name: EVENT_EXPANSION
regions.purpose: New event scripts. Reachable natively by 24-bit event operands ($B2 call, $C0-$CF jumps): bank = operand_hi + $CA.

regions.name: DIALOGUE_PTRS
regions.purpose: Expansion dialogue pointer table: 4096 entries x 4 bytes (lo, hi, bank, 0) for dialogue IDs $1000-$1FFF.

regions.name: DIALOGUE_TEXT
regions.purpose: Expansion dialogue strings (vanilla dialogue encoding, DTE-free).

regions.name: MAP_LAYOUTS
regions.purpose: Compressed (FF6 LZSS) BG layouts referenced by the 3-byte SubTilemap pointer table (D9:CD90, offsets relative to D9:D1B0; 24-bit add reaches F5). v0.4: all new layouts (indices $15F-$3FF via MAPX_SUBTILEMAP_PTRS).

regions.name: MAP_EXPANSION
regions.purpose: Reserved for map tables relocation (NPC/trigger/entrance) when slack is exhausted.

regions.name: MAPX_EVENT_TRIGGERS
regions.purpose: Relocated event-trigger table: 513 x 16-bit ptrs (rel. to table start) + 5-byte records. 12 consumers retargeted.

regions.name: MAPX_NPC_PROPS
regions.purpose: Relocated NPC table: 513 ptrs + 9-byte records. 21 consumers retargeted.

regions.name: MAPX_SHORT_ENTRANCES
regions.purpose: Relocated short entrances: 513 ptrs + 6-byte records. 19 consumers (13 field, 6 world).

regions.name: MAPX_LONG_ENTRANCES
regions.purpose: Relocated long entrances: 513 ptrs + 7-byte records. 19 consumers.

regions.name: MAPX_TREASURE
regions.purpose: Relocated treasure table: 513 ptrs (relative to record data) + 5-byte records. 12 consumers.

regions.name: MAPX_MAP_PROPS
regions.purpose: Relocated map properties: 512 rows x 33 bytes (maps $000-$1FF). 1 consumer (LoadMapProp).

regions.name: MAPX_SUBTILEMAP_PTRS
regions.purpose: Relocated layout pointer table: 1024 x 3-byte offsets from D9:D1B0 (10-bit layout index). 6 consumers.

regions.name: MAPX_NPC_EVENT_VECTORS
regions.purpose: NPC event vector table: 3-byte SNES addresses, indexed by NPC records whose 18-bit event field is $3xxxx (non-special NPCs). Consumer: M300 router.

regions.name: MAPX_SPARE
regions.purpose: Reserved for future map-table growth. (TECH v0.9.2: the QA target item-tech uses F7:A000-F7:FFFF for the relocated palettes.)

regions.name: MAPX_MAP_PAL
regions.purpose: TECH v0.9.2 QA: MapPal relocated (48 vanilla palettes byte-exact + new map palettes from index $30); consumer C0:266D (LoadMapPal)

regions.name: MAPX_SPRITE_PAL
regions.purpose: TECH v0.9.2 QA: MapSpritePal relocated (32 vanilla palettes byte-exact + new sprite palettes from index $20); consumers C0:50EE (InitSpritePal), C0:AA21 (event cmd $60)

regions.name: MONSTER_EXPANSION
regions.purpose: Reserved for monster expansion module (pending dependency audit approval).

regions.name: MONX_PROP
regions.purpose: Monster stats: 512 x 32 B (IDs $000-$1FF). Vanilla $000-$17F copied. 25 consumers.

regions.name: MONX_NAME
regions.purpose: Monster names: 512 x 10 B. 6 consumers (4 long, 2 immediates).

regions.name: MONX_SPECIAL_NAME
regions.purpose: Monster special-attack names: 512 x 10 B. 2 immediate consumers (bank + near base).

regions.name: MONX_ITEMS
regions.purpose: Steal/drop: 512 x 4 B. 2 consumers.

regions.name: MONX_CONTROL
regions.purpose: Control/muddled attacks: 512 x 4 B. 3 consumers.

regions.name: MONX_SKETCH
regions.purpose: Sketch attacks: 512 x 2 B. 1 consumer.

regions.name: MONX_SPECIAL_ANIM
regions.purpose: Special attack animation: 512 x 1 B. 2 consumers.

regions.name: MONX_OVERLAP
regions.purpose: Sprite-priority overlap shift: 512 x 1 B. 1 consumer.

regions.name: MONX_GFX_PROP
regions.purpose: Graphics properties: slots $000-$19F vanilla (monsters + espers/Imp), slots $1A0-$21E = monsters $180-$1FE (remapped by hooks N301/N302). 15 consumers.

regions.name: MONX_SPARE_1
regions.purpose: Reserved.

regions.name: FORMX_PROP
regions.purpose: Formation aux properties: 1024 x 4 B (formations $000-$3FF). 2 consumers.

regions.name: FORMX_MONSTERS
regions.purpose: Formation monster sets: 1024 x 15 B (+pad). 7 consumers.

regions.name: MONX_SPARE_2
regions.purpose: Reserved.

regions.name: FORMX_MAGIC_POINTS
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: BattleMagicPoints relocated, 1024 battles ($000-$1FF vanilla bytes, $200-$23F = 0 as vanilla, $240-$3FF per formation source)

regions.name: MONX_SPARE_3
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: remaining monster-module reserve

regions.name: MONX_AI_PTRS
regions.purpose: AI script pointers: 512 x 16-bit offsets (relative to MONX_AI_SCRIPT start). 1 consumer.

regions.name: MONX_AI_SCRIPT
regions.purpose: AI scripts: vanilla scripts copied at their original offsets + new scripts. 4 consumers.

regions.name: ITEM_EXPANSION
regions.purpose: BLOCKED for pre-v0.7.1 targets (item architecture approved as Option C in TECH v0.7; v0.7.1 targets use the ITEMX_* sub-regions).

regions.name: ITEMX_TABLES
regions.purpose: TECH v0.7.1: XItemProp (320x30, ids $000-$13F; $000-$0FF = D8:5000 copy), XItemName (320x13; $000-$0FF = D2:B300 copy), XExtFlags, XDescPtr/XDescText, XWeaponAnim. Consumers: 116 retargeted long operands (data/item_relocation_v071.json) + TECH v0.7.1 routines.

regions.name: ITEMX_CODE
regions.purpose: TECH v0.7.1: extended item engine (asm/item_v071), JSL targets from hook sites and bank stubs.

regions.name: GRAPHICS_EXPANSION
regions.purpose: Reserved for tiles/sprites/palettes/battle graphics.

regions.name: ENEMYX_PAL
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: MonsterPal relocated, 1024 x 16-byte units ($000-$2FF vanilla bytes, $300-$3FF new palettes)

regions.name: ENEMYX_STENCIL
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: MonsterStencil relocated: header + 256 small maps (128 vanilla) + 191 large maps (48 vanilla)

regions.name: ENEMYX_SPARE
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: enemy-module reserve (stencil/palette growth)

regions.name: ENEMYX_PAL_EMPTY_SLOT
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: LoadMonsterPal reads MonsterPal+$FFF0 (index $FFFF x 16, 16-bit X) for each EMPTY battle palette slot; holds the 16 vanilla bytes from D3:7810 so CGRAM stays identical to vanilla

regions.name: ENEMYX_GFX
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: custom enemy tile data (graphics index base FB:0000, MonsterGfxProp byte2 bit5)

regions.name: GRAPHICS_RESERVED_FE
regions.purpose: TECH v0.6: graphics reserve (not enemy module)

regions.name: UNALLOCATED
regions.purpose: Unassigned reserve bank.

regions.name: QA_HARNESS
regions.purpose: QA HARNESS ONLY (TECH v0.3.1 celes-qa target). Temporary QA access event + QA dialogue strings. Never active for production/celes-tech; the same range is UNALLOCATED (reserved) for every other target. TECH v0.4: QA access event/dialogue for target map-tech only.

regions.name: LEGACY_V01_CMDNAMES
regions.purpose: TECH v0.1 only: relocated battle-command-name table (32x7). NOT used by production.

regions.name: LEGACY_V01_SIGNATURE
regions.purpose: TECH v0.1 only: signature string.
